shortDescription: This module generates an authentication token for a user on IBM Spectrum Virtualize family storage system

options.name: clustername
options.description: The hostname or management IP of the Spectrum Virtualize storage system.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. Valid when hostname is used for the parameter I(clustername).

options.name: password
options.description: REST API password for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. This parameter is required in this module to generate the token.

options.name: token
options.description: The authentication token to verify a user on the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. This field is not required for ibm_svc_auth module.

options.name: username
options.description: REST API username for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system. This parameter is required in this module to generate the token.
